inspection_summary.note: Texas HHSC inspections, report investigations and assessments since October 2017, updated daily.

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training- Required Content: Two staff who administer medications did not have annual medication training within their last annual review date.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training- Required Content (26 TAC §746.1309(e))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Two of ten children's files reviewed for immunizations did not have current immunizations in their file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely: A seatbelt was frayed in one of three vehicles used to transport children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Types of Vehicles Used to Transport Children - Be Maintained Safely (26 TAC §746.5603(c))

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Training Requirements - Date: Review of four of four transportation training certificates revealed the certificate did not contain the date training was completed or the length of the training in hours completed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Training Requirements - Date (26 TAC §746.1329(b)(2))

occurrences.finding: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit: Three of three vehicles used to transport children did not have a complete first aid kit containing all required supplies.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Required Equipment in Vehicles - First-aid Kit (26 TAC §746.5617(a)(6))

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Immunizations: Five out of six children's files evaluated did not have current immunization records available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Immunizations (26 TAC §746.603(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: The operation does not have a signed food allergy emergency plan on file for the child with a known food allergy.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records Maintained: Six out of six children's files evaluated did not have current information in the files.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records Maintained (26 TAC §746.603(a))

occurrences.finding: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required: Four out of four staff files evaluated did not have training hours for the last training year available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documented Annual Training Area - 24 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1309(a))

occurrences.finding: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required: The director did not have training hours available for review for the last training year.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Director Annual Training 30 Hours Required (26 TAC §746.1311(a))

occurrences.finding: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date: An Epi-Pen assigned to a child with a food allergy did not have the original container labeled with the child's name. Note: This was corrected at inspection when the parent was notified and returned to the parent for disposal.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Administering Medication - Original Container with Child's Name, Date (26 TAC §746.3805(b)(1))

occurrences.finding: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection: The operations current gas inspection available for review during an inspection is expired.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Requirement of Gas Leak Inspection (26 TAC §746.5401)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 10 files were audited, 3 are missing health statements from a health care professional available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current: 10 files were audited, 3 are missing up to date immunization records available for review during this inspection.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Immunization Records, Exceptions, and Exemptions Current (26 TAC §746.613(b))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment: The playground has several toys that are dirty, and need to be repaired. There is also fungus growing in the mulch, and a gap in the gate of the fence that leads to the outside of the center.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance of Building, Grounds and Equipment (26 TAC §746.3407)

occurrences.finding: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps: Two high chairs in the infant room do not have the lap safety straps equiped on the chairs.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Infant Care Area Furnishings and Equipment -Use of Safety Straps (26 TAC §746.2407)

occurrences.finding: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards: There is a mouse trap in the toddler classroom located behind an unlocked door.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Safety - Areas Free From Hazards (26 TAC §746.3701)

occurrences.finding: Children's Records - Health Statement: 10 children's  files were checked, of those 5 do not contain a statement of health from a health care professional
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children's Records - Health Statement (26 TAC §746.603(a)(3))

occurrences.finding: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity: A child was unsupervised while in care when they exited the operation unnoticed.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Supervision ensures each child?s safety, well-being, including physical proximity and auditory or visual awareness of each child?s on going activity (26 TAC §746.1205(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited: During the course of an investigation conducted by DFPS, it was determined that child was neglectfully supervised by a caregiver. The child exited the facility unnoticed and was found by a passerby across the street. The child was gone for approximately 3 minutes and found unharmed before being brought back to the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: AP Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Ensure No Child Abused, Neglected, or Exploited (26 TAC §746.1201(4))

occurrences.finding: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required: It was found during a DFPS investigation that there were no additional caregivers available in the building during naptime.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Naptime Child/Caregiver Ratio - Additional Employee Required (26 TAC §746.1613(a)(4))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There is extensive debris on the large playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired: There is extensive debris on the large playground.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Maintenance Procedures for Active Play - Hazards Removed or Repaired (26 TAC §746.4751(c))

occurrences.finding: Release of Children: It was found that an identified parent was denied pickup of their children.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Release of Children (26 TAC §746.4101)

occurrences.finding: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children: There were nine children with one caregiver with a specified age group of 12 to 17 months. This was corrected at inspection when four children were moved to the other infant rooms.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Child/ Caregiver Ratio - 13 or More Children (26 TAC §746.1601)

occurrences.finding: Documentation of Fire Inspection: A current fire inspection was not available for review.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Documentation of Fire Inspection (26 TAC §746.5103)

occurrences.finding: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control: Caregivers failed to use good Judgment when they felt it was appropriate to speak to children in a disrespectful manner. Note: caregivers are no longer employed by the operation.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Responsibilities of Employees and Caregivers -Demonstrate Competency, Good Judgment, Self-control (26 TAC §746.1201(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment: A caregiver was heard threatening children with "touch it and you die" and "just get away from me 'cause I will end up in jail".
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Corporal Punishment (26 TAC §746.2805(1))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Using Harsh, Abusive or Profane Language: A caregiver was heard cursing at children.  The caregiver was also heard telling a child to perform a derogatory act on themselves.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Placing Child in Locked or Dark Room (26 TAC §746.2805(7))

occurrences.finding: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling: A caregiver was heard yelling at the children to stop crying and go to bed during nap.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Prohibited Punishments - Humiliating, Rejecting, Yelling (26 TAC §746.2805(6))

occurrences.finding: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained: The loose fill on the playgrounds have not been maintained since last inspection.  Loose fill did not measured at the proper depth.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Installation and Maintenance of Loose-fill Surfacing - Proper Depth Maintained (26 TAC §746.4907(d))

occurrences.finding: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training: 3 out of the 7 personnel files evaluated were missing annual training hours from the last full year of employement.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Training Requirements for Employees and Caregivers -  24 Annual Training (26 TAC §746.1301(5)(A))

occurrences.finding: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name: Nap cots in some of the classrooms were not labeled or numbered using a nap chart.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Cots, Beds, Mats Labeled With Child's Name (26 TAC §746.4503(b))

occurrences.finding: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional: A child with a diagnosed food allergy does not have a food allergy emergency plan signed by a health care professional on file.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Food Allergy Emergency Plan Signed by Parents and Health Care Professional (26 TAC §746.3819)

occurrences.finding: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering: Two children did not wash their hands right after having a diaper change. Their hands were washed after reminding the caregiver.
occurrences.violation_type_title: Children Handwashing After Toileting or Diapering (26 TAC §746.3417(3))
